scope: Normative signature, receiver-contract and structural grouping observations; execution NOT_RUN
invariants: P0 preserves written groups; int -> (int int) has one right argument and is not int -> int int.

In CODE/Expression, anonymous Structures and named different-parent Structures are groups; named Structures with the current lexical owner as parent use ordinary receiver/call handling. VALUE/TYPE/DATA gates remain, and reference resolution preserves actual parent.
Every :: argument is consumed as DATA, including the declaration identifier. Modifiers always consume their arguments as DATA.
Receivers retain their own resolved contracts in DATA and CODE; Expression is CODE, not implicit user Structure declaration.
Common Expression priorities prepare nested operations; :: has no DATA/value selector and does not call sys\eval on its received RHS.
When a receiving contract requires a declaration/field sequence, the common namespace mechanism reads immediate Structure fields or the target DATA fields of a reference. :: uses that mechanism.
Common Expression grouping produces current-level operation/sequence plans; a separate adapter packages one left actual and the right Array. No conditional opening pass follows grouping.
Receiving contracts select whole values/models or current-level sequences. Internal DATA field consumption does not recursively flatten models or change external arity.
Anonymous Structures are never invoked as callables; in CODE or Expression they execute in place without a new call activation.
Formal initializers, retained source, path inspection and signature inspection do not execute eagerly. Existing timing and generic RAW rules are unchanged.
The built-in :: implementation and operand metadata are absent; no PASS_ARGS_AS_IS value is assigned by assumption.
Ready signatures keep their positional-description profile and labels; physical service fields are not reinterpreted as formals.
Only the quoted -> receiver with one complete result TYPE is the documented nullary form; int -> () retains one empty right Structure.
All execution statuses remain NOT_RUN; no runtime, parser or compiler success is claimed.
